title: 单表全字段查询
description: 验证所有原子字段节点正确创建
sql: SELECT trans_id, mchnt_cd, trans_at FROM trans_flow
expected: 7 个 atomic 字段节点，field_references 无边

title: 单表部分列查询
description: 验证原子字段选择性创建，字段节点数等于引用列数
sql: SELECT trans_id, trans_at FROM trans_flow
expected: 2 个 atomic 字段（trans_id, trans_at），其他列不生成

title: nvl 表达式
description: 验证 nvl 二元函数生成 expression 节点，args 两个子节点
sql: SELECT nvl(mchnt_cd, 'UNKNOWN') AS safe_cd FROM trans_flow
expected: atomic(mchnt_cd) + literal('UNKNOWN') → nvl → alias(safe_cd)

title: round 除法表达式
description: 验证算术运算表达式的层级结构
sql: SELECT round(trans_at / 100, 2) AS yuan FROM trans_flow
expected: atomic(trans_at) + literal(100) → div → round → alias(yuan)

title: concat 表达式
description: 验证字符串拼接函数
sql: SELECT concat(trans_status, '_', 'SUFFIX') AS tagged FROM trans_flow
expected: atomic(trans_status) + literal('SUFFIX') → concat → alias(tagged)

title: CAST 类型转换
description: 验证 CAST 表达式保留 to_type 元信息
sql: SELECT CAST(region_cd AS STRING) AS rc FROM trans_flow
expected: atomic(region_cd) → cast(to_type=STRING) → alias(rc)

title: 组合表达式
description: 验证多表达式投影：nvl + round + concat 同时出现
sql: SELECT trans_id, nvl(mchnt_cd, 'UNKNOWN') AS mchnt_cd, round(trans_at / 100, 2) AS trans_at_yuan, concat(trans_status, '_', CAST(region_cd AS STRING)) AS status_region FROM trans_flow
expected: 8 个字段节点，层级清晰无交叉引用错误

title: 算术二元运算
description: 验证加减乘除等二元运算的字段生成和引用
sql: SELECT trans_at * 1.1 + 5 AS adjusted FROM trans_flow
expected: atomic(trans_at) → mul(1.1) → add(5) → alias(adjusted)

title: 简单聚合 sum + WHERE
description: 验证聚合函数被 groupby 包装，WHERE 条件独立
sql: SELECT sum(trans_at) AS total_at FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS'
expected: sum 节点 → groupby 包装，WHERE 以 field 节点包裹投影列

title: 多聚合 + GROUP BY
description: 验证多个聚合函数共享 group_keys，各聚合独立 groupby 包装
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, sum(trans_at) AS total_at, count(1) AS total_cnt, avg(trans_at) AS avg_at, max(trans_at) AS max_at, min(trans_at) AS min_at FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY mchnt_cd
expected: 5 个 groupby 节点共享同一个 group_key(mchnt_cd)

title: COUNT(*)
description: 验证 COUNT(*) 的 star 字面量处理
sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trans_flow
expected: star 字面量 → count → groupby(无 key)

title: 两表 LEFT JOIN
description: 验证 LEFT JOIN 仅右表字段包裹 JOIN 表达式，左表字段穿透
sql: SELECT a.trans_id, b.mchnt_nm FROM trans_flow a LEFT JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd
expected: a.trans_id 无 JOIN 包裹，b.mchnt_nm 有 JOIN 包裹

title: 两表 LEFT JOIN + 聚合
description: 验证 JOIN 与聚合同时出现时的层级叠加
sql: SELECT b.region_nm, count(1) AS trans_cnt FROM trans_flow a LEFT JOIN dim_domin b ON a.region_cd = b.region_cd WHERE a.trans_status = 'SUCCESS' AND a.trans_time >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND a.trans_time < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY b.region_nm
expected: region_nm 包 JOIN → groupby → WHERE，cnt 包 groupby → WHERE

title: 三表 LEFT JOIN + 聚合
description: 验证链式 LEFT JOIN：每步仅新的右表字段被包裹
sql: SELECT c.industry_nm, count(1) AS refund_cnt, sum(a.trans_at) AS refund_at FROM trans_flow a LEFT JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd LEFT JOIN dim_industry c ON b.industry_id = c.industry_id WHERE a.trans_status = 'REFUND' AND c.industry_nm = '酒店' AND a.trans_time >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND a.trans_time < '2026-07-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.industry_nm
expected: a 列无 JOIN，b 列 JOIN(cond1)，c 列 JOIN(cond2)

title: 简单子查询（FROM 子查询）
description: 验证子查询作为独立公民，外层引用子查询投影列
sql: SELECT t.trans_id FROM (SELECT trans_id FROM trans_flow) t
expected: 1 个内层 subquery + 1 个外层 subquery，引用链正确

title: 聚合子查询（嵌套）
description: 验证子查询+聚合的嵌套结构，内外 group_keys 独立
sql: SELECT a.mchnt_cd, a.total_cnt, a.total_at FROM (SELECT mchnt_cd, count(1) AS total_cnt, sum(trans_at) AS total_at FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY mchnt_cd) a WHERE a.total_cnt > 10
expected: 内层子查询产生 groupby 节点，外层引用已聚合并包 WHERE

title: CASE WHEN（含 ELSE）
description: 验证 casewhen 表达式的条件分支结构
sql: SELECT trans_id, trans_at, CASE WHEN trans_at > 10000 THEN '大额' WHEN trans_at > 1000 THEN '中额' WHEN trans_at > 100 THEN '小额' ELSE '微额' END AS amt_level FROM trans_flow
expected: 4 个 WHEN 分支(condition+value) + 1 个 ELSE → casewhen → alias

title: CASE WHEN（无 ELSE）
description: 验证 CASE WHEN 在无 ELSE 时的处理（最后一个 condition=null）
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN trans_at > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' END AS level FROM trans_flow
expected: 1 个 WHEN 分支(condition+value)，无 ELSE 则最后 condition=null

title: AND/OR 组合条件
description: 验证复合条件被扁平化（嵌套 AND/OR 展开为同一层）
sql: SELECT sum(trans_at) as trans_at, count(*) AS cnt FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS' AND (trans_at > 500 OR mchnt_cd IN ('M001', 'M002'))
expected: AND 节点 args 包含扁平化的子条件列表

title: IN / NOT IN 条件
description: 验证 IN 和 NOT IN 条件的字段结构
sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'REFUND') AND mchnt_cd NOT IN ('M9999')
expected: 2 个条件节点（in 和 notin），各自引用字段+字面量列表

title: IS NOT NULL 条件
description: 验证一元条件 IS NULL / IS NOT NULL
sql: SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_at IS NOT NULL
expected: is 条件节点，args 包含 trans_at + Null 字面量

title: 复合嵌套条件
description: 验证多层 AND/OR/IN/NOT IN 嵌套的扁平化处理
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT usr_id) AS cnt FROM usr_behave_bury bu WHERE bu.behave_time >= '2026-06-01' AND (bu.behave_type = 'CLICK' OR bu.behave_type = 'VIEW') AND bu.mchnt_cd NOT IN ('M9999')
expected: AND 节点 args 含 is + or(展开) + notin

title: sink 表绑定（middle 表写入）
description: 验证 sink 表写入后 table_input_subqueries + table_column_mappings 正确创建
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, date_format(trans_time, 'yyyyMMdd') AS stat_date, count(1) AS trans_cnt, sum(trans_at) AS trans_at, sum(CASE WHEN trans_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succ_cnt FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_time >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY mchnt_cd, date_format(trans_time, 'yyyyMMdd')
expected: 5 个 table_column_mappings 按 ordinal_position 对齐 dws_mchnt_day

title: UNION ALL
description: 验证 UNION 子查询的两个分支独立构建，共享重叠字段
sql: SELECT trans_id FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT trans_id FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'REFUND'
expected: 2 个 SELECT 分支子查询 + 1 个 UNION 顶层子查询，trans_id 原子字段复用

title: UNION + 聚合（middle 表）
description: 验证 UNION 引用 middle 表字段的链路
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, 'day' AS stat_level, stat_date AS stat_time, trans_cnt, trans_at FROM dws_mchnt_day WHERE stat_date >= '20260601' UNION ALL SELECT mchnt_cd, 'month' AS stat_level, substring(stat_date, 1, 6) AS stat_time, sum(trans_cnt) AS trans_cnt, sum(trans_at) AS trans_at FROM dws_mchnt_day WHERE stat_date >= '20260601' GROUP BY mchnt_cd, substring(stat_date, 1, 6)
expected: dws_mchnt_day 字段通过 table_column_mappings 解析

title: 窗口函数 ROW_NUMBER
description: 验证 window 表达式的 partition_by + order_by 结构
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, trans_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mchnt_cd ORDER BY trans_time) AS rn FROM trans_flow
expected: window 节点含 partition_by=[mchnt_cd], order_by=[trans_time]

title: 窗口函数 SUM + 累计求和
description: 验证 SUM OVER 窗口函数的 cumsum 语义
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, trans_id, trans_at, trans_time, sum(trans_at) OVER (PARTITION BY mchnt_cd ORDER BY trans_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumsum_at FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS'
expected: window 节点含 frame: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

title: 简单 CTE（单层 WITH）
description: 验证 CTE 作为独立子查询构建，主查询引用 CTE 别名
sql: WITH succ_trans AS (SELECT mchnt_cd, trans_at, trans_time FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS') SELECT mchnt_cd, sum(trans_at) AS total_at FROM succ_trans GROUP BY mchnt_cd
expected: CTE 子查询独立，主查询通过 alias_map 解析 CTE 列

title: 多层 CTE（WITH 链）
description: 验证多个 CTE 之间的引用关系
sql: WITH succ AS (SELECT mchnt_cd, trans_at, trans_time FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_status = 'SUCCESS'), stats AS (SELECT mchnt_cd, sum(trans_at) AS total_at, count(1) AS cnt FROM succ GROUP BY mchnt_cd) SELECT a.mchnt_cd, b.mchnt_nm, a.total_at, a.cnt FROM stats a LEFT JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd
expected: succ → stats → 主查询，三层引用链正确

title: 3 表连续 INNER JOIN
description: 验证累积 JOIN 包裹：a 列包两层，b 列包两层，c 列包一层
sql: SELECT a.trans_id, b.mchnt_nm, c.industry_nm FROM trans_flow a INNER JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd INNER JOIN dim_industry c ON b.industry_id = c.industry_id
expected: a: JOIN(JOIN(atomic, cond1), cond2), b: JOIN(JOIN(atomic, cond1), cond2), c: JOIN(atomic, cond2)

title: INNER + LEFT 混合 JOIN
description: 验证先 INNER（左右都包）再 LEFT（仅右表包）的混合语义
sql: SELECT a.trans_id, b.mchnt_nm, c.industry_nm FROM trans_flow a INNER JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd LEFT JOIN dim_industry c ON b.industry_id = c.industry_id
expected: a 包 cond1，b 包 cond1，c 包 cond2（不包 cond1）

title: LATERAL VIEW explode
description: 验证 lateral view 的 JOIN(lateral=true) 表达式
sql: SELECT mchnt_cd, mchnt_nm, industry_tag FROM dim_mchnt LATERAL VIEW explode(split(industry_list, ',')) t AS industry_tag
expected: JOIN 节点含 lateral: true 标记

title: RIGHT JOIN 转 LEFT JOIN
description: 验证 RIGHT JOIN 被 normalizer 自动转换为 LEFT JOIN
sql: SELECT a.trans_id, b.mchnt_nm FROM trans_flow a RIGHT JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd
expected: 等价于 FROM dim_mchnt b LEFT JOIN trans_flow a，a 列包 JOIN

title: VIEW 创建与查询
description: 验证 VIEW 作为虚拟表的字段解析（通过子查询 projection）
sql: SELECT mchnt_nm, industry_id FROM dim_mchnt
expected: VIEW 通过子查询 projection 按 alias 匹配字段 hash
view_create: CREATE VIEW v_mchnt_brief AS SELECT mchnt_nm, industry_id FROM dim_mchnt

title: 枚举值解析（DDL COMMENT ENUM）
description: 验证 DDL COMMENT 中 ENUM(...) 解析并写入 field_enums
sql: SELECT trans_status FROM trans_flow
expected: field_enums 中有 trans_status 的 ['SUCCESS','FAIL','REFUND']

title: 枚举值 alias 继承
description: 验证 alias 节点继承内层字段的枚举值
sql: SELECT trans_status AS status FROM trans_flow
expected: alias(status) 继承 trans_status 的枚举值

title: 枚举值 JOIN 继承
description: 验证 JOIN 节点继承被包裹字段的枚举值
sql: SELECT a.trans_id, b.mchnt_nm FROM trans_flow a INNER JOIN dim_mchnt b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd
expected: a.trans_id 的 JOIN 节点继承 trans_id 的枚举值

title: FULL JOIN 转 UNION
description: 验证 FULL OUTER JOIN 被 normalizer 转换为 (LEFT JOIN) UNION (LEFT JOIN)
sql: SELECT coalesce(a.mchnt_cd, b.mchnt_cd) AS mchnt_cd, a.trans_cnt, b.behave_cnt FROM (SELECT mchnt_cd, count(1) AS trans_cnt FROM trans_flow WHERE trans_time >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY mchnt_cd) a FULL JOIN (SELECT mchnt_cd, count(1) AS behave_cnt FROM usr_behave_bury WHERE behave_time >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY mchnt_cd) b ON a.mchnt_cd = b.mchnt_cd
expected: 产生 UNION 子查询，两个分支分别为 LEFT JOIN
